feature-views-chat-desc: Sabuuradda oo ah goob sheekeysi: goobaha shaqada, sabuuradaha, waddooyinka, liisaska iyo kaararka oo ah geed kanaalo, kaarka dhexda iyo faallooyinkiisa oo ah fariimo sheekeysi.

feature-views-email-desc: Sabuuradda oo ah sanduuq boosto: liiska iimaylku waa Sanduuqa soo galay, liisasku waa galal, calaamaduhu waa calaamado, xubnuhuna waxay ka qoraan kana jawaabaan iimaylada cinwaanka sabuuradda.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Shaqada hartay iyo tan dhammaatay, socodka isu ururay, waqtiga wareegga iyo gudbinta, tirada shaqada dhammaatay, da'da shaqada, caqabadaha, Monte Carlo iyo cabbirrada kale ee socodka.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaararka oo calaamado ka ah sawir la soo geliyey.
feature-views-overview-desc: Tirakoob, kooxayn qofka loo xilsaaray, qorshaha waddada, muraayadda maamulka iyo sabuurad weyn.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Liiska shaqada badeecadda, wareegyada shaqada gaaban, warbixinta wareegga iyo xawaaraha.
feature-views-table-desc: Sabuuradda oo ah jadwal kaarar ah oo la kala hormarin karo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Looxa oo ah raadraaca arrimaha GitHub ama Gitea: kaararka oo ah arrimo, calaamado iyo hiigsiyo, faallooyinka oo ah wadahadalka, lifaaqyada oo ah faylal, iyo taariikhda looxa oo leh dib-u-celin.
